name: Tooltip
summary: Short non-interactive supplemental content linked to one focusable trigger, with hover, focus, controlled-open, Escape-dismissed, and target-owned positioning behavior.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Inline positioning wrapper around exactly one trigger and one Tooltip content node.

anatomy.name: trigger
anatomy.description: Consumer-owned focusable trigger that retains its own accessible name and references the Tooltip content.

anatomy.name: content
anatomy.description: Explicit short non-interactive content node with role tooltip and a target-owned id.

anatomy.name: arrow
anatomy.description: Decorative arrow that visually relates the content to its trigger.

states.name: hidden
states.description: Resting content is visually hidden and does not receive pointer events.

states.name: hover
states.description: Hovering either trigger or content keeps the Tooltip visible.

states.name: focus
states.description: Focus within the trigger path reveals the Tooltip while focus remains on the trigger.

states.name: open
states.description: Target-controlled open state reveals the Tooltip.

states.name: dismissed
states.description: Escape temporarily suppresses visible content without moving focus.

behavior.name: descriptionRelationship
behavior.description: The trigger references the explicit Tooltip content by id so supplemental content does not replace the trigger's accessible name.

behavior.name: visibility
behavior.description: Tooltip appears on pointer hover, trigger focus, or an explicit target-controlled open state.

behavior.name: hoverPersistence
behavior.description: Pointer can move from the trigger onto the Tooltip content without closing it, and content remains until hover/focus ends or it is dismissed.

behavior.name: dismissal
behavior.description: Escape dismisses without moving focus; leaving the complete hover/focus path closes normally and clears temporary dismissal.

behavior.name: nonInteractive
behavior.description: Tooltip content remains short and non-interactive; use Popover or visible content for controls, required instructions, validation, or rich structure.

behavior.name: targetPositioning
behavior.description: Targets own collision detection, portals/top layer, alternative placement, delay coordination, and global mutual exclusion.

properties.name: content
properties.description: Short supplemental plain text rendered in the Tooltip content node.

properties.name: trigger
properties.description: Exactly one focusable consumer-owned trigger with its own visible and accessible name.

properties.name: open
properties.description: Optional target-controlled visible state; ordinary web triggers still reveal content on hover and focus.

accessibility: Preserve the trigger's accessible name and reference Tooltip content with aria-describedby.
Render explicit content with role="tooltip" and a unique target-owned id.
Reveal on hover and focus, keep content hoverable and persistent, and support Escape dismissal without moving focus.
Keep content short and non-interactive; required information must remain visible elsewhere.
Do not depend on Tooltip for touch-only access to essential information.

web.notes: Canonical CSS owns presentation; the consuming target owns ids, Escape state, delay, and collision behavior.

shopify.notes: Use Shopify host Tooltip/interestFor where available; theme targets may emit the neutral DOM relationship and target behavior.
